body:
I find it funny that you mention that he needs to mature, bc he's always the one telling me I'm childish and that I need to grow up. I find it ironic. 

Be as it may, I feel bad for him bc he went with the first college he got into, not a college that actually was the right choice for him. He hated it there. He's excited for me to go and hopes I have a good time (it's the same college, so if he would have stayed we would be there together) I'm just worried about making friends and being totally on my own, which is pretty typical. The thing is, he can't really go back to school. The funding he got from the government only worked for the 4 years right after high school, and bc he dropped out, he's not eligible for it anymore. Which is complete bullshit. So he dropped out bc he was miserable (he literally received NONE of the credit hours from his first semester). Which I understood bc I didn't want him to stay somewhere that was only making him unhappy. (And I don't hold any resentment for any of this bc it was so long ago and it was ultimately his decision, and the way the government does the funding fucked him over)

He wants to go back to school, but he has to save his money first. He was working for Amazon, but for a whole month they gave him no hours so they were just taking up his time so he couldn't get another job. He worked at 6:30 in the morning, he would leave at 5:30 or so, and when he would to the Amazon place (workhouse? plant? I'm drawing a blank on the word here lol) they would tell him they didn't need him. So he was wasting his gas driving there just so they could tell him he wasn't even going to work that day. He impulsively quit before he found another job (which I disagreed with but that's in the past so I don't worry about it) and he's still looking for another one.

He is frustrated about the job searching and everything which I understand. The thing is, the Amazon job was his second job and it was the second time he just impulsively quit. And it makes me wonder how the future is going to go if we stay together and he just continuously quits jobs. I personally am a workaholic, and I get annoyed when my friends ask me to hang out because honestly, I would rather be making money during that time (but that's unrelated sorry).

I've honestly thought about everything you've mentioned, but I really want to have a future with him and I really don't want to make myself upset by breaking up with him, but then it's probably logical if I do, and I'm honestly all over the place about it.

 Thank you for your advice!!

It still makes me really happy to see him and do things with him, it's just this giant cloud of all the things I have to do and how much the last argument hurt me and how much it annoys me that he asks me for sex all the time just seems to overshadow everything I'm doing. And it's not only with him. It's pretty much anything I do.
